subject: Jennifer Skane Introduction as Andrews Principal
overview: Principal Jennifer Skane introduces herself to the community and outlines the academic programs, extracurricular activities, and educational philosophy at Andrews Middle School.

items.title: School Legacy and Principal Introduction
items.summary: Principal Jennifer Skane introduces herself and discusses the legacy of Madeline Duggar Andrews, the school's namesake and Medford's first African American woman on the school committee.

items.title: Professional Experience and Educational Philosophy
items.summary: Skane details her 27-year background in education and her commitment to providing an inclusive learning environment where every student can thrive.

items.title: Academic Programs and World Languages
items.summary: The principal outlines core academic courses, fine arts electives, and world language options including Spanish, French, and Italian.

items.title: Extracurricular Activities and Athletics
items.summary: Skane highlights various clubs and athletic opportunities available to students, emphasizing the importance of learning outside the classroom.

items.title: School Motto and Community Engagement
items.summary: The principal emphasizes the school motto of excellence through responsibility and respect and expresses her commitment to the school community.
